t2.title: It better to learn a skill from videos online or from a teacher in…
t2.prompt: A student magazine announced an article writing contest. The best ones will be published in the magazine. Write your article on this topic: "Is it better to learn a skill from videos online or from a teacher in person?" Write 180–200 words, giving reasons and examples.
t2.sample:
With the rise of online learning, many people now learn skills from videos rather than in-person instruction. Both methods have advantages, but I believe a combination works best.

Online videos offer significant benefits. They are accessible anytime, anywhere, and can be paused or rewatched. For self-motivated learners, platforms like YouTube provide free, high-quality tutorials on almost any skill. The flexibility suits busy schedules.

However, in-person instruction provides advantages videos cannot. Teachers offer immediate feedback and can correct mistakes before they become habits. They adapt their teaching to individual learning styles and answer specific questions. For complex skills like playing instruments or sports, physical guidance is invaluable.

Furthermore, teachers provide motivation and accountability that videos lack. Many people start online courses but never finish them without external encouragement.

The ideal approach combines both methods – using videos for theoretical knowledge and practice, while seeking periodic guidance from experienced teachers for feedback and correction.

In conclusion, neither method is universally superior. The best choice depends on the skill, the learner's circumstances, and available resources.

t2.sampleB2:
Learning Skills: Screen or Teacher?

These days, you can pick up almost any skill with a few taps on your phone — but does a video really beat a teacher standing right beside you? It's a question worth exploring.

There's no denying that online videos have plenty going for them. They are free, available around the clock, and you can pause or rewind whenever something doesn't sink in. For anyone with a busy schedule, learning at your own pace is a huge plus, and platforms like YouTube cover everything from coding to cooking, often taught by genuine experts.

That said, a teacher in person offers something a screen simply cannot. They spot your mistakes on the spot and correct them before bad habits creep in. They can also read the room, adjust their explanations, and keep you motivated when your enthusiasm starts to fade.

In my view, the smartest approach is to combine the two. Watch videos to grasp the basics, then turn to a teacher for feedback and that personal touch that no algorithm can replicate. After all, why settle for one when both can work hand in hand?
t2.uzSample:
Onlayn ta’limning rivojlanishi bilan ko‘pchilik odamlar endi ko‘nikmalarni shaxsan o‘qituvchidan emas, balki videolardan o‘rganmoqdalar. Ikkala usulning ham afzalliklari bor, lekin menimcha, ularning kombinatsiyasi eng yaxshi ishlaydi.

Onlayn videolar sezilarli afzalliklarni taqdim etadi. Ular istalgan vaqtda, istalgan joyda mavjud va ularni to‘xtatib qo‘yish yoki qayta ko‘rish mumkin. O‘z-o‘zini rag‘batlantira oladigan o‘quvchilar uchun YouTube kabi platformalar deyarli har qanday ko‘nikma bo‘yicha bepul, yuqori sifatli qo‘llanmalarni taqdim etadi. Moslashuvchanlik band bo‘lgan jadvalga mos keladi.

Biroq, shaxsan o‘qitish videolar bera olmaydigan afzalliklarni taqdim etadi. O‘qituvchilar darhol fikr-mulohaza berishadi va xatolarni odatga aylanishidan oldin tuzatishlari mumkin. Ular o‘zlarining o‘qitish uslublarini individual o‘rganish uslublariga moslashtiradilar va aniq savollarga javob beradilar. Musiqa asboblarini chalish yoki sport bilan shug‘ullanish kabi murakkab ko‘nikmalar uchun jismoniy yo‘l-yo‘riq beqiyosdir.

Bundan tashqari, o‘qituvchilar videolarda yetishmaydigan motivatsiya va javobgarlikni ta’minlaydilar. Ko‘pchilik odamlar onlayn kurslarni boshlaydilar, lekin tashqi rag‘batlantirishsiz ularni hech qachon tugatmaydilar.

Ideal yondashuv ikkala usulni birlashtiradi – nazariy bilim va amaliyot uchun videolardan foydalanish, shu bilan birga fikr-mulohaza va tuzatish uchun tajribali o‘qituvchilardan vaqti-vaqti bilan yo‘l-yo‘riq so‘rash.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, hech bir usul universal ustun emas. Eng yaxshi tanlov ko‘nikmaga, o‘quvchining sharoitlariga va mavjud resurslarga bog‘liq.

t12.sample: Dear LearnSmart Support, Thank you for asking about my experience with your online tutoring platform. I am very pleased with the quality of tutoring. My math tutor is patient and explains complex concepts in simple terms. The interactive whiteboard feature is particularly useful for solving problems together. The flexible scheduling fits perfectly with my busy timetable. However, I have noticed some areas for improvement. Occasionally, the video connection is unstable, which disrupts lessons. Investing in better server infrastructure would solve this. Additionally, I would appreciate more practice materials and homework resources after each session. A progress tracking feature showing improvement over time would also be motivating. Overall, LearnSmart has boosted my confidence and grades significantly. Yours sincerely, Sabina Aliyeva
